data.name: Amitie
data.gender_notes: Amitie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the French word ‘amitié’ meaning ‘friendship’. In Christian tradition, Amitie symbolizes the bond between believers and God, as well as the brotherly love among Christians. The name Amitie carries the meaning “Friendship” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Amitie usually hope their child will grow to embody friendship and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of Christian unity and companionship with the divine.
data.etymology: Amitie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friendship.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amitie total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: אמיטיה
in_hebrew.meaning: אמיטיה - שם נשים נוצרי עם משמעות ידידות ואהבה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אמיטיה הוא שם נשים נוצרי שמקורו במילה האנגלית 'Amitie', שפירושה ידידות ואהבה. השם אמיטיה נגזר מהמילה הצרפתית 'amitie', שמשמעותה ידידות, והוא משמש ככינוי לאישה שמייצגת את התכונות של אהבה וידידות. השם אמיטיה אינו מופיע ישירות בתנ"ך העברי, אך הוא קשור לנושאים של אהבה ויחסים בין אישיים, שמהווים מרכיב מרכזי בערכי הנצרות.

in_greek.name: Αμιτί
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αμιτί προέρχεται από τη γαλλική λέξη 'amitie', που σημαίνει φιλία. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με τις αρετές της αγάπης και της φιλίας, που είναι θεμελιώδεις για τη χριστιανική πίστη. Αν και δεν υπάρχει άμεση αναφορά στο όνομα Αμιτί στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η έννοια της φιλίας και της αγάπης είναι κεντρική στο χριστιανικό μήνυμα.

in_latin.name: Amitie
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Amitie originates from the Latin word 'amicia', meaning friendship. In Christian tradition, Amitie symbolizes the values of love and companionship. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the concept of friendship and love is a significant theme in Christian teachings, reflecting the importance of interpersonal relationships and community.

in_english.name: Amitie
in_english.meaning: Amitie means friendship, love, and affection in Christian tradition
in_english.long_meaning: The name Amitie, derived from the French word for 'friendship', embodies the Christian values of love, compassion, and companionship. While not a direct reference to any biblical scripture, the concept of Amitie aligns with the biblical teachings on the importance of loving one another and building strong relationships within the Christian community. Historically, the name Amitie has been used to signify a deep bond of friendship and affection, reflecting the spiritual significance of interpersonal connections in Christian tradition.

data.cultural_impact: Amitie, as a Christian name derived from the French word for 'friendship', highlights the importance of building and fostering relationships in Christian culture. This name encourages an atmosphere of closeness, support, and communal love among believers.
data.spiritual_significance: Simultaneously, the spiritual significance of Amitie emphasizes the intimate bond between individuals and God. The name Amitie, with its emphasis on friendship, is a constant reminder of the sacred relationship we have with God and with one another.
